space.name: Fitness Room
space.note: A100 wall poche bounding box. The room is notched at its north-west corner: the lobby corridor pocket U 221.8 to 230.6, V 25.7 to 29.2 (entry door at U 226.5 to 229.3 in the V 25.7 wall, PA-311 console in the pocket) is outside the room. The guest laundry wall face at V 29.18 runs U 230.6 to 246.39 with the Spin2Cycle door to Guest Laundry 024 at about U 230.7 to 234.3.

calibration.ID-1.7: Sheet page rotation 270. In the displayed frame the fitness face of the lobby wall is x 1468.3 pt (U 221.79) and the inside of the south exterior wall is x 1800.5 pt (U 246.39): 332.2 pt for 24.60 ft = 13.50 pt/ft. The fitness face of the guest laundry wall is y 1013.6 pt (V 29.18); the west exterior face then lands at y 1500.3, which matches the drawn wall end at 1500.2. U = 221.79 + (x - 1468.3) / 13.5, V = 29.18 - (y - 1013.6) / 13.5.
calibration.A510.3: Same construction: lobby wall face x 1431.1, south face x 1763.3 (332.2 pt), laundry wall face y 815.6. U = 221.79 + (x - 1431.1) / 13.5, V = 29.18 - (y - 815.6) / 13.5.

The Drive cutsheet 'BOTTLE FILLER FITNESS.pdf' (1Gq4kara0CeFfoRZlwJFohS0Pj6ur3wna) is an Elkay built-in refrigerated dispenser, 5 1/8 x 18 x 20 1/2 in; no plan shows one in the fitness room, so none is drawn.
PA-400 and PA-401 roller shades, PA-506, wall graphics (ID-3.2 view 5): window and wall finishes, not massing.
notes: ID-1.7 (2025) and A510.3 (2023) disagree on the equipment layout. A510.3 has two treadmills and one elliptical at the south-west, a functional trainer and a ball rack on the east side, a bike at the north-east and an exercise ball by the rack. ID-1.7 has four treadmills, two ellipticals and a recumbent bike in one cardio row along the south windows. ID-1.7 is the later FF&E plan and governs the kit.

The angled strength piece is the one judgment call: its symbol is untagged on ID-1.7 and A510.3's boxed equipment list carries no per-symbol leaders. It is drawn as the 808 strength system and labeled so in the code comment.
Cardio and strength equipment is owner-furnished per the Home2 fitness guide (A510.3 keyed note 2 refers to it); no vendor cutsheet is in the Drive, so every equipment footprint is SCALED.
